# Cached real evidence

May and July scene files contain real Basel hourly observations and Rotterdam archive reanalysis; their river sensitivity values are configured separately as simulated. October contains real negative-gauge observations. No synthetic gauge value is stored in a measured array.

The heat daily maximum is separately cached and never substituted for hourly ambient. Provider/source metadata stays with each file. Actual Kaub window coverage starts 2 September; the requested filename is retained and metadata records that coverage gap. Raw and obsolete draft files stay local in ignored data/raw/.

Repeated fetch preserves historical scene caches. Audit fresh downloads before intentionally changing committed evidence. Provider terms and verification status live in docs/SOURCES.md and config/verification.yaml.
